انحجبن (form VII)
# اِنْحَجَبْنَ (inḥajabna) /in.ħa.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# اِنْحَجِبْنَ (inḥajibna) /in.ħa.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
